Agent Name: Coder
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The simulation modeled only a single piston firing and then stopped, measuring which of the initial three balls (1, 2, or 3) gets ejected on the first shot (~1/3 each) instead of simulating the full process until the chosen ball is either ejected by a piston (win) or released (loss). This misimplementation (and implicit restriction to balls 1–3) led to incorrect probabilities and the wrong final choice, contradicting the correct answer (3).
